C-SEARCH-RELEASE-359.Summary: Complete optional meaning-assisted retrieval and publish release 0.4.7 using the existing exact-main release workflow.
C-SEARCH-RELEASE-359.Problem: PR 357 contains read-only background selection, while the subsequent topical retrieval patch has not reached the repository or full application CI. A release must include actual retrieval beyond the initial result and preserve offline search, permissions, immutable sources and the tested upgrade path.

Goals.Goal: Use the existing FTS index for conversational Russian queries, bounded word-form and spelling fallback, and optional LLM query expansion.
Keep explicit filters and authorization in every retrieval; validate source IDs and exact quotations; cancel stale work and retain useful partial results.
Expose related queries and materials through the current search and canonical object routes without a chat, automatic business writes or reordered primary results.
Publish 0.4.7 from exact main only after regression, backup/recovery and verification of the same Debian/Astra artifacts that are published.

Constraints.Constraint: Acceptance authority is issue 359 with feature scope from 358 and PR 357. Verified main is ca0ecd3e61c817e35b009f0738e2a59a1fa38525; pending integration parent is a6744eeba37d05597da244ede4069e7e8ffc92a4.
SQLite schema remains 31. No applied migration, immutable source, stored evidence, PIN or ACL policy changes. Temporary FTS vocabulary is a read projection, not a new persistent index.
The model is optional, receives only authorized source fragments, has no write tools, and cannot remove explicit filters or assert completion/publication.
Use the existing release workflow; include the new search regression in its critical browser set. Build each OS archive only once, then verify and publish those exact bytes.

PR project CI and targeted browser verification own their tests; GRACE performs lint/scope only for this change. Full deployment/recovery remains the single release verification, not a duplicate PR bundle build.
Archive the completed C-ASTRA-OCR-BUNDLE-353 unchanged except applied status in this same integration.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Automatic attachment to official reports, changing task completion, signatures, external sending or a new vector database.
Claim quality of real LLM retrieval or physical Astra kernel/PARSEC acceptance from fixtures and UBI checks.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: The query about an article on cyclones in a report finds current indexed reports, articles and protocol sources without requiring every conversational word.
An initially empty result may gain actual authorized documents through model-proposed query variants; variants with no accessible results are not shown.
Explicit filters survive variants and related-material actions. Source versions open their canonical documents and return to the original search context.
Unauthorized, revoked, archived and obsolete source versions are excluded from default suggestions; fresh checks happen before source text is sent and before cached output is returned.
Invalid JSON, invented IDs/quotes, timeouts and cancellation never corrupt or block ordinary search. Queue and prompt/response budgets remain bounded.
Full project tests, authenticated API regression, desktop/mobile search regression and existing ACL regression pass on the exact PR head.
Version metadata is consistent at 0.4.7, release notes describe the diff from v0.4.6, and release publication is verified through GitHub API without modifying previous assets.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Exact-head CI and focused browser checks, then one exact-main Release with verified Debian 12/Astra 1.7/Astra 1.8 artifacts and an upgrade from published 0.4.6.
